{{Quote|Space station ''Valor'', this is Colonel Meebur Gascon. Can anyone hear me?|[[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]]|<ref name="PONR">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>}}
'''''Valor''''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At the height of the war, the [[Space station/Legends|station]] was the site of a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|strategy conference]].

==Description==
[[File:ValorStationPeltedByDebris-PoNR.png|thumb|left|250px|''Valor'' being pelted by debris from the destroyed cruiser ''Renown'']]
The space station had three large docking arms around a central superstructure.<ref name="I138" /> It was similar in design to a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Spaceport THX1138|space station]] that operated later on, during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="STTAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

Each of the 3 docking arms, consisted of 3 hangars making a total of 9 ship hangars. The central superstructure was a facility dedicated for strategic planning and was protected by turrets and turbolasers.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the star base hosted a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|strategy conference]].<ref name="I138" /> During the conference, the station was targeted by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], who filled the derelict Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' with [[Rhydonium/Legends|explosives]] and sent the ship through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to destroy the station. The members of [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], a covert droid [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] unit lead by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], found themselves on board the deserted cruiser after traveling from the planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].<ref name="PONR" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to [[Star Wars Insider 138|''Insider 138'']] the station's design was based on the [[Spaceport THX1138|station]] featured in [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride.<ref name="I138" />
